subject.title: fix(doctor): surface multi-account default routing warnings in preview and lint

question: Should missing explicit multi-account default routing become a default warning-level openclaw doctor --lint finding that returns a nonzero lint exit?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but the default lint severity changes operator gate behavior for existing configs and needs maintainer compatibility intent.

options.title: Accept default lint warning
options.body: Land the PR with the new check in default lint selection, accepting that ambiguous multi-account routing configs now fail `doctor --lint` at warning severity.

options.title: Make lint opt-in first
options.body: Keep preview/fix output but mark the structured check default-disabled so operators can run it with `--all` or `--only` until a later default-enablement decision.

options.title: Wait for routing semantics
options.body: Pause this PR until the missing-accountId routing direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93338 is resolved, then align the warning text and lint default with that decision.

recommendation.title: Accept default lint warning
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the new check in default lint selection, accepting that ambiguous multi-account routing configs now fail `doctor --lint` at warning severity.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent structured doctor lint and health-contribution history makes this the strongest owner signal for the default lint behavior decision.
